class.name: Awakened Martial Artist Class
lore: Choose the Awakened Martial Artist Class

skills.name: Agile Striker
lore: While sprinting, crouch to perform a long rapid dash forward.

skills.name: Martial Combo
lore: Unleash a chain of strikes:
First Strike: A left strike forward.
Second Strike: A right strike forward followed by an uppercut,
slightly knocking up enemies.
Third Strike: A down strike that brings down enemies, followed
by a double left - right strike.
Fourth Strike: Charge for 0.5s and dash forward instantly,
striking and slightly knocking back enemies. Hit enemies get stunned
for a short duration.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Ground Blow
lore: Run forward grabbing all enemies in your path. At the end of
your run, leap up and strike down your enemies towards the ground,
stunning them.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Multistrike Uppercut
lore: Strike forward 5 times rapidly and perform a leaping uppercut,
knocking up enemies.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Heavy Shockwave
lore: Perform a strong punch that pushes back enemies. Charge an aura
that brings aerial energy inwards and strike forward, creating a
long shockwave that pushes back and stuns enemies.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Spinning Blow
lore: Perform a left spinning kick followed by a right spinning kick,
both striking nearby enemies twice. If you're on the ground, kick
down and strike the surface, knocking up enemies. If you're midair,
the downstrike kick knocks down enemies to the ground instead.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Dragon Strike
lore: Engage forward, striking 5 times in a row and stomp the surface,
knocking up nearby enemies. Enemies enter slow motion, floating
midair. Teleport to 3 different enemies, striking each area
3 times, 2 times, 3 times. Teleport back to your original
position in the air, striking down all enemies towards the ground,
leaving them stunned. Step back and leap upwards, summoning
spiritual dragons on both side and smash down towards the surface
with powerful force, strongly damaging and knocking up enemies.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
